turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question on the new quantization specs I saw in the draft doc. What scale format are they using for the MXFP4 blocks?
Based on the draft you referenced, it mentions they are using E4M3 scale format.
Got it. E4M3 it is. By the way, did the replacement fan for the server rack arrive? It was supposed to be here by Friday.
The tracking number shows it delivered to the front desk on Thursday afternoon.
Great, thanks. I'll grab it after lunch. Also, any update on that coffee machine leak? The office is getting annoyed.
Maintenance said they scheduled a technician for tomorrow morning to fix the valve.
Perfect. Back to the specs - just confirming, the draft definitely says E4M3 scale format for MXFP4, right?
Yes, the draft document you shared explicitly states E4M3 scale format.
Okay, noted. Thanks Lloyd.
You're welcome, Alan.
Lloyd, I need to update the config file for the new MXFP4 release. The final spec just came out and they changed the scale format.
Oh? What is the final specification?
It's switched to E8M0 scale format. Power-of-two only. We need to make sure the compiler uses that.
Understood. I'll note that the final spec uses E8M0 scale format.
Thanks. Also, did you see the weather alert for next week? They're predicting heavy rain.
Yes, I saw that. You might want to keep your umbrella handy.
Definitely. I also need to reschedule my dentist appointment if it's going to be pouring.
I can send a reminder to reschedule if you'd like.
Not yet, let's wait and see. But back to the code - make sure the config reflects the new scale format.
Will do. I'll ensure the configuration aligns with the E8M0 requirement.
Great. Thanks.
Anytime, Alan.
